title_vi: Tường lửa hoạt động thế nào?

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

claims.evidence: Source read; one Linux kernel documentation page read from raw GitHub; the stateless versus stateful difference observed by running nftables on loopback; descriptions of circuit-level gateways, application gateways and NGFWs come from the source and general knowledge only.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: The source describes a firewall as a network security system that controls and filters traffic between a private network and the public Internet, software-based or hardware-based, and lists five types: packet filtering, circuit-level gateways, application-level gateways (proxy firewalls), stateful inspection and next-generation firewalls.
Linux's netfilter connection tracking keeps entries for the flows it tracks, which is the basis of stateful filtering.
claims.section: nf_conntrack sysctl variables (nf_conntrack_count: number of currently allocated flow entries)
claims.verified_by: Read from a copy of the Linux kernel documentation fetched from raw GitHub.

claims.claim_vi: Observed with nftables on loopback port 18081 (a table created for the test and deleted afterwards): with no rules a client connects and receives data; with rules that accept packets to port 18081 and drop packets from port 18081 and no state, the TCP handshake does not complete (timeout); with ct state established,related accept plus a rule allowing only new connections to port 18081 the connection succeeds; with new connections to 18081 dropped the connection times out.
claims.verified_by: No external page reports this output; observed by executing the code on the authoring machine. The source only describes tracking active connections; the rule that drops every packet from the source port is a deliberately naive stateless setup, and the run did not try a port-based rule that lets replies through.

claims.claim_vi: In the deliberately simplified ruleset of the run, replies would need an extra rule on the source port, which would also admit other packets claiming that port; this is a limit of that ruleset, not of every packet filter.
claims.verified_by: Author's inference from how a stateless rule works; real stateless filters can also narrow rules by address, direction, destination port and TCP flags such as ACK or RST but keep no table of open connections. The source only says packet filtering accepts or rejects by source, destination or protocol. Not run.

claims.claim_vi: Circuit-level gateways, application-level gateways and next-generation firewalls are described as in the source (TCP handshake monitoring; sitting between network and traffic source; integration with intrusion prevention, deep packet analysis and application awareness); the lesson adds that a proxy accepts the connection on behalf of the internal host.
claims.section: Circuit-level Gateways; Application-level Gateways; Next-Generation Firewalls
claims.verified_by: Source body read; the proxy wording and the claim that more inspection usually costs more resources are the author's general knowledge, not checked against a standard.

design_notes_vi: Một câu hỏi chung đi qua năm loại tường lửa theo thứ tự của bài nguồn, mỗi loại một thẻ nói nó nhìn vào gì; thẻ cuối nêu giới hạn. Không xếp độ sâu vì không có nguồn. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source gives one line per type and says firewalls come as software or hardware; the lesson keeps the source order, states what each type looks at without ranking the types by depth, and runs the difference between port-only and stateful filtering.
Source calls the application-level gateway a filter 'between your network and traffic source'; the lesson says a proxy accepts the connection for the internal host, from general knowledge.
Source's 'kids and adults' framing is not used.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
